facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2022-0226 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 21 November 2022 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including RN-2011-002. The change assurance record covers 2 clauses across 4 controlled documents. The intent is to strengthen the material unwanted event control named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state abandoned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2026-0413, PRO-MEC-014 and PRO-OPS-032.
